commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-ipo-hwq-final.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="347bcca2901cd4e5d4b52bf27301cad27411ce2a"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "SOURCE_SHA|$EXPECTED"
make test-ipo
echo "IPO_NEW_FULL_TARGET|PASS"
grep -R -n -m2 'GROWBOX_STAGE28_REAL_OUTPUTS_ENABLED' CMakeLists.txt cmake src scripts config 2>/dev/null | head -14 || true
if test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-120; then echo "AUTHORIZED_DEVICE_NODE|PRESENT_UNTOUCHED"; else echo "AUTHORIZED_DEVICE_NODE|ABSENT"; fi
test ! -e /dev/cu.usbserial-10 || echo "PROHIBITED_DEVICE_NODE|PRESENT_UNTOUCHED"
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_CLEAN|PASS"
